name: Execute
description: A devastating blow that deals massive damage to low health enemies.

name: Battle Cry
description: Let loose a fierce cry that increases your damage for a short time.

name: Slam
description: Slam your weapon into the ground, damaging all nearby enemies.

name: Heroic Strike
description: A powerful strike infused with combat experience.

name: Rend
description: Tear into the enemy causing them to bleed over time.

name: Overpower
description: Exploit an opening to deal increased damage that cannot be blocked.

name: Mortal Strike
description: A vicious strike that reduces healing received by the target.

name: Thunder Clap
description: Slam the ground creating a shockwave that damages and slows enemies.

name: Hamstring
description: Maim the enemy, significantly reducing their movement speed.

name: Sweeping Strikes
description: Your attacks hit an additional nearby enemy for a duration.

name: Pummel
description: Interrupt an enemy spellcast and lock them out of that school.

name: Intimidating Shout
description: Cause enemies to flee in fear for a short duration.

name: Recklessness
description: Enter a reckless state where all attacks critically strike.

name: Colossus Smash
description: Smash through enemy armor, making them vulnerable to damage.

name: Bladestorm
description: Become a whirlwind of blades, hitting all enemies around you.

name: Rallying Cry
description: Rally your allies, temporarily increasing everyones maximum health.

name: Commanding Shout
description: Shout commands that increase your party attack power.

name: Shattering Throw
description: Throw your weapon to shatter enemy magical shields.

name: Avatar
description: Transform into an unstoppable force, immune to movement impairing effects.

name: Deadly Calm
description: Enter a state of focus where abilities cost no rage for a duration.
